judgment.notes: At S002, M001 has A=Q, source indexing type I, and every source module equal to the local vector space T. H001 and D005 give the finite enumeration |I|=λ+1=n. F001 gives finite generation and a finite basis by deletion of dependent vectors. Q is a semiring with the stated strong rank condition: an injective linear map carries the standard independent family into Q^t, where elimination bounds its size by t. Thus the supplied signature's semiring, StrongRankCondition, Fintype, AddCommMonoid, Module, Free and Finite requirements are met, and its conclusion is precisely dim_Q(T^I)=Σ_i r=nr. Source dummy T and local T are explicitly distinguished in the bindings. The routine facts used in S001–S003 have their actual conditions available, as recorded in BG001–BG003.

S001 correctly balances the multiplication map and reduces every tensor to a common-denominator pure tensor, proving injectivity without assuming rational rank one. S002 constructs the finite-product tensor isomorphism with an explicit inverse and extends an n-element R-basis by its coordinate maps, so both dimensions of the tensorized N003 isomorphism are justified. Since n=nr and n>0, r=1; injectivity of θ then gives exactly the rational proportionality used in S003. For a finite nonempty generating family, removing powers of p produces integer orders and units of R. In S004 the minimum is attained, every generator is an R-multiple of b, and a minimizing generator recovers b using a unit inverse. Hence b is nonzero, b∈J and J=Rb. N003 gives spanning by the b e_i; complex independence of e_i and b≠0 give R-independence. All clauses of N004 follow. No limiting operation is involved.
